title: (RHBA-2017:1049) redhat-support-plugin-rhev bug fix and enhancement update for RHV 4.1
portal_summary: Updated redhat-support-plugin-rhev packages that fix several bugs and add various enhancements are now available.
portal_synopsis: redhat-support-plugin-rhev bug fix and enhancement update for RHV 4.1
portal_solution:
Before applying this update, make sure all previously released errata
relevant to your system have been applied.

For details on how to apply this update, refer to:

https://access.redhat.com/articles/2974891
portal_description:
The Red Hat Support plug-in for Red Hat Virtualization offers seamless integrated access to Red Hat subscription services from the Red Hat Virtualization administration portal. The plug-in provides automated functionality that enables quicker help, answers, and proactive
services. It offers easy and instant access to Red Hat exclusive knowledge, resources, engagement, and diagnostic features.
